mapper.sql: f.id AS id, f.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.realname, ''), u.username) AS userName, u.avatar AS userAvatar, f.type AS type, f.title AS title, f.content AS content, f.status AS status, f.like_count AS likeCount, f.comment_count AS commentCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ts_feedback_like fl WHERE fl.user_id = #{query.currentUserId} AND fl.target_type = 'feedback' AND fl.target_id = f.id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS liked, f.created_at AS createdAt, f.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS id, f.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.realname, ''), u.username) AS userName, u.avatar AS userAvatar, f.type AS type, f.title AS title, f.content AS content, f.status AS status, f.like_count AS likeCount, f.comment_count AS commentCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ts_feedback_like fl WHERE fl.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND fl.target_type = 'feedback' AND fl.target_id = f.id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS liked, f.created_at AS createdAt, f.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ts_feedback f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE f.id = #{feedbackId} AND f.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, feedback_id AS feedbackId, user_id AS userId, content, created_at AS createdAt FROM ts_feedback_append WHERE feedback_id = #{feedbackId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, file_url AS fileUrl, file_type AS fileType, created_at AS createdAt FROM ts_feedback_attachment WHERE feedback_id = #{feedbackId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ts_feedback SET like_count = like_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{feedbackId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE ts_feedback SET comment_count = comment_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{feedbackId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT like_count FROM ts_feedback WHERE id = #{feedbackId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
